entries.a17e668f190b01ad: As a certified basic broadcasting business using broadcasting satellites under the Broadcasting Act, it operates BS digital high-definition broadcasting (channel 211ch, remote control ID 11) and provides free nationwide broadcasts with a general programming lineup of news, educational, entertainment, advertising and shopping programs. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2026 was ¥9,989 million.
entries.a2db28cdb555337c: Its management philosophy is 'Provide high-quality information to move people and contribute to building a happy society,' and as a satellite basic broadcasting operator, it is founded on maintaining and expanding the earnings capacity of its BS digital broadcasting business. Its overall strategy 'Value4' sets as priority measures 'maximizing broadcasting business revenue,' 'accelerating development of original IP content,' 'expanding the earnings base of the anime business' and 'strategic investment for enhancing corporate value,' and it states that it plans to succeed and evolve these measures into 'Value3' for the next period.

entries.a50ce2b801d8e232: Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2026 were ¥11,921 million. Broken down, broadcasting business was ¥9,989 million (time revenue ¥7,883 million, spot revenue ¥2,105 million), and other businesses were ¥1,932 million.

entries.d268e30e98ed1135: This is the revenue category earned by selling time slots between programs and similar slots to advertisers by the second and broadcasting advertisers' CMs. Sales in the fiscal year ended August 2026 were ¥2,105 million.
entries.d809a11999afebb7: In the fiscal year ended August 2026, spot revenue increased while time revenue decreased, so broadcasting business revenue fell below the previous year; however, streaming business revenue and investment dividend income from the anime production committee grew, increasing other business revenue, and total net sales exceeded the previous year.

Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2026 was ¥1,932 million.
